info.title: CSEDU Students' Club Management System API
info.description:
Comprehensive REST API documentation for CSEDU Students' Club Management System. Powered by Microservices & API Gateway.

**Base URLs:**
- Production Base URL: `https://csedusc-formula1.farefin.com`
- Local Gateway: `http://localhost:4000`
